## Load Packages and Data

```{r}
library(gotta)
library(Matrix) # fill holes

toy_path <- system.file(
  "extdata",
  "example-object-sma-mouse-heart-3-toy.rds",
  package = "gotta"
)
if (!nzchar(toy_path)) {
  toy_path <- normalizePath(
    file.path("..", "inst", "extdata", "example-object-sma-mouse-heart-3-toy.rds"),
    mustWork = TRUE
  )
}

object <- readRDS(toy_path)

fig_dir <- if (dir.exists(normalizePath(file.path("..", "man", "figures"), mustWork = FALSE))) {
  normalizePath(file.path("..", "man", "figures"), mustWork = FALSE)
} else {
  file.path(tempdir(), "quick-start-figures")
}
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

save_quick_start_plot <- function(plot, filename, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 150) {
  out_path <- file.path(fig_dir, filename)
  ggplot2::ggsave(out_path, plot = plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
  out_path
}

save_quick_start_widget_png <- function(widget, filename, width = 1400, height = 1000) {
  html_path <- file.path(fig_dir, sub("\\.png$", ".html", filename))
  lib_dir <- file.path(fig_dir, sub("\\.png$", "_files", filename))
  out_path <- file.path(fig_dir, filename)

  htmlwidgets::saveWidget(widget, file = html_path, selfcontained = FALSE, libdir = lib_dir)

  edge_path <- "C:/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft/Edge/Application/msedge.exe"
  if (!file.exists(edge_path)) {
    stop("Microsoft Edge not found; cannot render plotly widget to PNG.")
  }

  html_uri <- paste0("file:///", normalizePath(html_path, winslash = "/"))
  cmd <- sprintf(
    "\"%s\" --headless --disable-gpu --hide-scrollbars --window-size=%d,%d --screenshot=\"%s\" \"%s\"",
    edge_path,
    width,
    height,
    normalizePath(out_path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE),
    html_uri
  )
  status <- system(cmd, intern = FALSE, ignore.stdout = TRUE, ignore.stderr = FALSE)
  if (!identical(status, 0L) || !file.exists(out_path)) {
    stop("Failed to render plotly widget to PNG.")
  }

  unlink(c(html_path, lib_dir), recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)

  out_path
}
```

## Build the Spatial Mesh

```{r}
vertex.job <- VertexJob(reduction = "rnapca", n.components = 10)
gott.job <- GOTTJob(vertex.job = vertex.job, shape = "free_boundary")

object <- FindSpatialNeighbors(object, col.names = c("original_y", "original_x"), verbose = TRUE)
object <- ComputeCellArea(object, vertex.job = vertex.job, verbose = TRUE)
```

### Region Labels on the Spatial Layout

```{r}
spatial_mesh_plot <- MeshFeaturePlot(
  object,
  layout.name = "spatial_coords",
  features = "RegionLoupe"
)
spatial_mesh_png <- save_quick_start_plot(
  spatial_mesh_plot,
  "quick-start-spatial-regionloupe.png"
)
knitr::include_graphics(spatial_mesh_png)
```

### Cell Area on the Spatial Layout

```{r}
spatial_area_plot <- SurfFeaturePlot(
  object,
  layout.name = "spatial_coords",
  features = "area.rnapca"
)
spatial_area_png <- save_quick_start_plot(
  spatial_area_plot,
  "quick-start-spatial-area-rnapca.png"
)
knitr::include_graphics(spatial_area_png)
```

## Run GOTT on the RNA PCA Geometry

```{r}
object <- RunGOTT(object, gott.job = gott.job, is.pseudo.initial = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
```

### Region Labels on the GOTT Layout

```{r}
gott_mesh_plot <- MeshFeaturePlot(
  object,
  layout.name = "rnapca.free_boundary",
  features = "RegionLoupe"
)
gott_mesh_png <- save_quick_start_plot(
  gott_mesh_plot,
  "quick-start-gott-regionloupe.png"
)
knitr::include_graphics(gott_mesh_png)
```

### Cell Area on the GOTT Layout


## Build the HyperView Embedding

```{r}
object <- RunHyperView(object, vertex.job = vertex.job, layout.name = "rnapca.free_boundary")
```

### Region Labels on the HyperView Mesh

```{r}
hyperview_plot <- HyperMeshFeaturePlot(
  object,
  layout.name = "rnapca.free_boundary",
  features = "RegionLoupe"
)
hyperview_png <- save_quick_start_widget_png(
  hyperview_plot,
  "quick-start-hyperview-regionloupe.png"
)
knitr::include_graphics(hyperview_png)
```
